GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. got up fence turn 2 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok eased back to last 5-6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping made contact with the nearside barrier partition and shortly after shifted out and bumped. Was then shifted behind runners from a wide barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 lengths Settled Down last 12 lengths. last turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer was told that a warning would be recorded against the mare which was fractious in the barriers prior to the start and lunged forward just prior to the start being affected and was consequently slow to begin. Passing the 600m was hampered and taken out to avoid another runner which ran out abruptly when racing greenly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. battled away # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. got up fence turn 3 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd & led narrowly on inside early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & outgunned in last 200m. # Led & weakened.
Jumped Well from a low draw. Went Forward led on rail x half a length @ 800m. Headed on Straightening Up then had nothing left in the tank. # weak once headed
Slow Out 2 Lengths , Settled back last 9 Lengths 600m, came widest Straightening Up but was still out the back, she really got going last 100m and Made Good Ground late # best work late

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1 length 3 Wide , worked up to Two Wide joint Lead 750m, kept going and went clear, led Two Wide by 1 length turning, Headed 150m and weakened from there. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME, Winker (Off Side) FIRST TIME) # worked early/fair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Two Wide Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden and hung 3 Wide on turn, weakened in Straight # on pace/weakened
Jumped Fair pressed on to be 4l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 3l off, battled on well without the clearest path in straight, need to see again # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near 350m was hampered by another runner. Raced greenly over the final 200m.
